reason: Seal the 13 oldest post-migration status records and keep the three newest, which are exactly the records closing CLAIM-VERIFICATION-ADOPTION.7, so the snapshot still opens on the current day. Sized against the reachable headroom rather than the committed root: the pinned 40-record migration suffix alone consumes 66,720 of the 92,000-byte warning budget, so no cut can leave more than about 25,000 bytes free. Keeping all seven same-day records would leave only about seven records of headroom, the outcome STATUS-LEDGER-ROLLOVER.3 warns against; keeping three leaves about eleven, matching what .3 achieved.
